entries.note_hr: Sjeverna Dalmacija: mjestimice jak sjeverozapadni vjetar. Najjači udari vjetra 35-40 čvorova (65-75 km/h). Vrijedi od 25.05.2026 15:00 do 25.05.2026 20:00.
entries.note_en: Northern Dalmatia: locally strong north-westerly wind. Strongest gusts 35-40 knots (65-75 km/h). Valid 25 May 2026 from 15:00 to 20:00.
entries.gear: Windproof layer recommended; secure loose equipment.

entries.note_hr: Južna Dalmacija: mjestimice pojačana bura. Najjači udari vjetra 35-40 čvorova (65-75 km/h). Vrijedi od 25.05.2026 00:00 do 25.05.2026 08:00.
entries.note_en: Southern Dalmatia: locally strong bora wind. Strongest gusts 35-40 knots (65-75 km/h). Valid 25 May 2026 from 00:00 to 08:00.
entries.gear: Windproof layer recommended; secure loose equipment.

entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: NP Sjeverni Velebit: na oba ulaza (Babić Siča i Alan) plaćanje je moguće isključivo GOTOVINOM. Ulaz Babić Siča radi pon-ned 8:00-16:00; ulaz Alan - ulaznice se kupuju kod dežurnog čuvara prirode.
entries.note_en: NP Sjeverni Velebit: payment at both entrances (Babić Siča and Alan) is possible exclusively in CASH. Babić Siča entrance is open Mon-Sun 08:00-16:00; Alan entrance - tickets purchased from the on-duty nature warden.
